description: HydroPandas is Artesia's Python package for reading, analysing and writing hydrological time series together with station metadata. It extends pandas objects to represent individual observations and collections, including groundwater, surface-water levels, water quality and meteorology. Inputs are supported provider APIs or files such as BRO XML, DINO CSV and FEWS XML; outputs are organised time-series objects and reusable exports. Geographic coverage follows the source, including the Netherlands, global climate or groundwater services and South Australia. Public source is free under MIT. A limitation is that source availability, measurement quality and credentials differ across providers, and a common container does not make observations directly comparable. The README recommends separate collections for different measurement types. HydroPandas can prepare calibration and boundary data for water-infrastructure simulations, complementary to Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). The repository links source-specific notebooks and documents metadata handling. No observation series or external account was accessed.
